terminal_record.title: Unverified allegation of Marshals surveillance targeting federal judges
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges Marshals surveillance and intimidation of judges; its cited reporting documents judicial-security concerns, not the alleged program.
terminal_record.date_start_basis: Supplied original date; the specific alleged incidents are unverified.

source_fact_map.fact: Reuters reported that the federal judiciary launched a security-and-independence task force on March 26 amid criticism of judges; this is contextual reporting and does not establish the alleged Marshals program.
source_fact_map.quote: The U.S. federal judiciary on Wednesday launched a task force focused on ensuring the continued security and independence of the courts
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: March 26 (Reuters) - The U.S. federal judiciary on Wednesday launched a task force focused on ensuring the continued security and independence of the courts as Republican President Donald Trump and his allies ramp up their criticism of judges who block his agenda.
